title: Yellow Roasted Vietnamese Nectarine Skewers
description: A sweet and savory Vietnamese dish featuring roasted nectarines, perfect for a flexitarian snack or dessert. The combination of juicy nectarines and crispy fried shallots is a nostalgic treat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced shallots to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the shallots until crispy.
Thread a nectarine chunk, a few fried shallots, and a sprinkle of chopped mint leaves onto each bamboo skewer.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 15 minutes.
Brush the nectarines with the remaining sauce from the bowl and continue roasting for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
